findings.finding: Both quotations resolve. The source supports bilingual CEBiasBench, direct generation versus Multi-Agent Cultural Debate, cultural personas and structured deliberation. The English GPT-4o condition reports 57.6/86.0 for MACD and 47.6/69.0 for direct generation under the two named evaluation routes.
The category mapping is grounded in explicit prompt-language experiments, cultural personas, bias measures and mitigation. No claim extends the study to Gender or Soziale_Arbeit.
Five cultural domains, discrete labels and absence of repeated multi-run evaluation are correctly bounded. Linearised tables support the numeric claims; figure content is not needed for them.
